schema_version.description: the version of the type's schema; each type's schema fixes the value

aliases.description: other names the record is written as

locked.description: field paths (for example `summary`, `must_read.era`) no job may change; a human edits them

review.description: agent-owned: what the Critic concluded about a model-written text. Identical in atlas-research-content and atlas-news-content

score.description: 0 to 10, worked out by code from the Critic's verdicts

generated_by_code.description: agent-owned: the job run that wrote a record code copied from its source; no model wrote any of it. Identical in atlas-research-content and atlas-news-content

generated_by_model.description: agent-owned: the job run that wrote a record's text, with the provider, model and prompt version that wrote it. Identical in atlas-research-content and atlas-news-content

generated_by.description: agent-owned: the job run that wrote the record; it names a provider, model and prompt version exactly when a model wrote text in it

arxiv_fields.description: what the `arxiv` fetch tool read from the arXiv API for one paper; a value arXiv does not state is left out

version.description: the version of the paper that was read

authors.description: one entry per author, in the paper's order

categories.description: arXiv categories, the primary one included

doi.description: absent when arXiv lists no DOI

comment.description: the authors' comment; absent when there is none

updated.description: when arXiv last updated the paper, as arXiv writes it

huggingface_papers_fields.description: what the `huggingface-papers` fetch tool read from Hugging Face Papers for one paper

authors.description: one entry per author, in the paper's order

upvotes.description: upvotes on Hugging Face Papers when the paper was read

comments.description: comments on Hugging Face Papers when the paper was read

rss_fields.description: what the `rss` fetch tool read from a feed entry

author.description: absent when the feed names no author

categories.description: the entry's categories as the feed lists them; empty when it lists none

feed_item.description: the part of a `feed-item` record that atlas-research-content and atlas-news-content share. The two repositories keep this definition, and every definition it refers to, identical; each adds its own `kind` values in its feed-item schema

url.description: canonical address of the item; unique across the repository

source.description: name of the `config/sources.yaml` entry that delivered the item

source_tool.description: the fetch tool that read the item; it decides the shape of `fields`

published_at.description: UTC timestamp the source published the item; null when the source gave none

relevance.description: the score a model gave the item; absent on an item code copied, which no one scored

quote.description: the passage of the source the summary rests on, word for word; absent on an item code copied

credit.description: the licence or credit line the source requires, as its `config/sources.yaml` entry stated it when the item was read

fields.description: values copied from the source by code; one shape per `source_tool`

allOf.description: `fields` has the shape of the tool named in `source_tool`
an item a model wrote states its score, quote and review; an item code copied states none of them
